name: What is the difference between single-pane and double-pane window repair?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between single-pane and double-pane window repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: The main difference in repair for single-pane versus double-pane windows lies in the glass unit itself. A single-pane window repair involves replacing a single sheet of glass. For double-pane (insulated) windows, the repair typically requires replacing the entire sealed unit, which consists of two panes of glass separated by a spacer and gas fill. This difference affects both the cost and the availability of materials, as IGUs are custom-made to fit specific window frames. The repair process for double-pane windows is generally more involved due to the sealed unit's complexity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Single-pane repair replaces one glass sheet, while double-pane repair involves replacing the entire sealed insulated glass unit, affecting cost and material availability.
